# RSH-12 attribution and local source

Rsh-12 by Medji
Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/rsh-12-177cd570002d4e89bd378ec328a47f9c
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Modified for FPSGAME: normalized model units; selected the closed revolver
assembly; native 715 skeleton binding; five copies of the author's cartridge;
mechanical pivot and hand-contact pose deltas; source PBR materials and native
weapon-surface/weather adapter; production inventory icon.

The animation sequences and native first-person arms are project resources,
not part of Medji's Sketchfab model. No endorsement by the source author is
claimed. The official archive and source metadata are retained locally in
SourceAssets/RSH12Integration20261003/Original and sketchfab_metadata.json.
